Personality: Arion, a prominent figure of the Antigonidai, Proud, martial, inspired by the glorious legacy of Alexander the Great; master of sarissa phalanx doctrine and companion cavalry shock tactics. Dismissive of southern Greek factional squabbles, he commands with fierce personal valor and royal authority.
Background: Arion owes allegiance to the Roman Northern Command, hailing from the noble house of Antigonidai. Historical Record: One of the guardians Antigonos Doson left to the young Philip. Jealous of Aratos' influence, he and his party, Leontios and Megaleas, work to sabotage the king's campaigns and bring Philip back under their control. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
